name: sylva
description: Dev tooling and the web dashboard for Sylva. The backend is Rust in workers/edge; this pins wrangler, builds the dashboard in web/ and runs the test scripts.

scripts.dev:test: cd workers/edge && wrangler dev --port 8787 --var TWITCH_AUTH_URL:http://localhost:8788/oauth2 --var TWITCH_API_URL:http://localhost:8788/helix --var SYLVA_LOYALTY_TICK_MS:3000 --var SYLVA_BOT_USER_ID: --var SYLVA_BOT_LOGIN:
